verdict.rationale: Skyvern's own GitHub description says it maps visual elements to actions on sites it has never seen. Its llms.txt describes it as using LLMs and computer vision, and it uses a vision model to detect and solve CAPTCHAs, so vision-driven interaction is a first-party capability. However, nothing shows a selectable vision or computer-use mode that a developer switches to, or screenshot-coordinate actions on canvases and non-DOM UIs. Missing for 10: a documented switchable vision/computer-use action mode, explicit canvas/non-DOM UI support, screenshot-coordinate action primitives, independent hands-on corroboration.
